title: Systemic immune dysregulation and local barrier failure as predictors of septic shock in acute appendicitis: a large-scale multicenter interpretable machine learning study
summary: In a 3,000-patient multicenter study, the Random Forest achieved ROC-AUC 0.914 in training and 0.812 in the independent external cohort. The authors explicitly describe SHAP findings as predictive associations, not biological causality or synergy. Retrospective training cohort n=1,400, internal test n=600, independent external cohort n=1,000; the locked model was evaluated without refitting on validation cohorts. Prospective clinical-impact evaluation remains untested.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and comparison of eight supervised algorithms yielded a Random Forest risk model; SHAP attributed model predictions to clinical and ultrasound features.
